narrative.overview:
zerosoft is white, black and zeros. The mark is a zero (an oval ring, ZeroMark) next to "zerosoft.ai" in lowercase mono; the site's first viewport is a big zero made of small zeros (ZeroField). Everything else is quiet: white field, ink type, 1px rules, 3px corners. Color belongs to the eleven apps and only says where you are (the app's zero, the active item, a chart).

Type is Space Grotesk for reading, interface and headings (500 for titles) and IBM Plex Mono for data, code and the wordmark. Flat: no shadows, gradients or pills.

**Brand themes.** This is the default theme. Optional themes restyle the same structure through tokens in styles/themes/<theme>.css under html[data-brand], chosen with ?brand=<theme> (cookie zs_brand). Today: "Red de subte" (apps as subway lines, zeros as stations), guide at /[locale]/nuevo-branding/subte. See DESIGN.md, Themes.
keyCharacteristics: White field, ink text, 1px rules; ink bands only for the closing band, footer and code.
Eleven app colors as accents, each paired with a darkened text ink.
The zero is the logo, favicon, app icon and every app mark (the zero in its color).
Space Grotesk for everything read or operated; IBM Plex Mono for values and the wordmark.
3px corners on controls; no shadows, gradients, pills or emoji.

rules.name: The Ink-For-Text Rule
rules.body: An app color is never set as text. Text in an app's color uses its `-ink` variant; text on an app fill uses its `-on` value.

rules.name: The Labeled Color Rule
rules.body: An app color never carries meaning alone: the zero sits next to the app's name.

rules.name: The Logo Is Ink Rule
rules.body: The zerosoft zero and wordmark are ink or white only. A colored zero is an app's mark, never zerosoft's.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono is for values, code and the wordmark. Buttons and navigation are Space Grotesk, sentence case.

rules.name: The Lowercase Name Rule
rules.body: The name is always "zerosoft.ai" (or "zerosoft") in lowercase, next to the zero.

rules.name: The Theme Token Rule
rules.body: Brand values come from the theme tokens (--brand-*, --font-*, --signage-*, --chrome-*, --stroke-rule). A theme's look never leaks outside its theme file or component.

dos: **Do** use the zero as the only brand shape, and the app's zero in its color as its mark.
**Do** use the `-ink` variant for text in an app's color and the `-on` value on an app fill.
**Do** read every brand value from the theme tokens.
**Do** keep text at gray-3 (#6e6e6e) or darker.
**Do** separate surfaces by plane or a 1px rule.
donts: **Don't** hardcode a theme's look (condensed 800 titles, 4px rules, black chrome, stations) outside its theme.
**Don't** use pills, emoji or decorative circles.
**Don't** set a raw app color as text, or let it stand without its name.
**Don't** color the zerosoft zero with an app color, stretch it, or retype the name in another font.
**Don't** set buttons or navigation in mono or uppercase.
